angle: The host is reading a book with her phone face down, and the property keeps running anyway. The notification pile fans open one card at a time as the proof: a guest answered at 2am, a cleaner dispatched at 9, a rate tuned in the afternoon, another guest answered at dinner.
brief: Motion cut of the off-the-clock stack still, on the new animated-stack composition. The photo drifts in under a slow Ken Burns push, the wordmark fades on, the pile lands collapsed and fans open downward like an iOS notification group, then the headline, subhead and CTA stagger up. Same day-back-evening photo, scrims, and solid-white copy as the still. pillar: relief, funnel: convert, angle: day-reclaimed.
